scope: Retrospective geometry and milepost correction to the represented 40-mile operating network; no new track, rights, equipment, service, cost, or revenue
boundary_basis: Newly authored maintenance-district stations on the proposed corrected centerlines. The old endpoints can miss the new centerline by 69.403 m and are not projected into asset boundaries. Stable asset IDs are retained as crosswalk keys; an ID suffix is historical, not its current milepost.
proposed_leads_and_ladders: Excluded from operating route, asset, capital and collateral populations until separately accepted and placed in service
